doc.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Joseph Jarman joke and leaving Wilson College
summary: A light aside on Jarman's marriage, then confirming he stayed only a semester before committing to music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: What did you say about how Joseph Jarman's wife blamed you for breaking up their marriage?
Well, Joseph blames me! His wife got on his case about me saying, "Can we use your place?"
So how long did that last? Until you got the space, until Muhal got the space?
Yeah, different people [laughs] yeah that's funny... Where do you want to go next?
Well, the chronology… Most of the biographies say you left Wilson college, so you didn't finish?
Do you remember how long you actually attended?
I think I stayed there maybe a semester.
Because then I decided I'm just going to go sink or swim with music. Being a full time musician.
And so we'll try to place this chronology at 64, 65, but definitely before 66,
